source.title: Hersteller von Kraftfahrzeugen und -anhängern, alphabetisch (SV 3.1)
source.section: PDF pages 6–150; row ordinal top to bottom within each page; columns Herstellerklartext, KBA, WMI Teil 1/2, vollständige Herstellerbezeichnung, Herstellerstandort
source.reuseBasis: KBA SV 3.1, 15 January 2026, PDF page 151 (Impressum): reproduction and dissemination, including partial, digital and indirectly obtained content, are permitted with acknowledgement of the source. Factual rows are extracted and normalized with KBA attribution; original documents are not redistributed.
source.modifications: Datenquelle: Kraftfahrt-Bundesamt, SV 3.1, Stand 15. Januar 2026, Abruf 26. September 2026; eigene Darstellung. Factual columns extracted and normalized into VIN-matching rules by orVIN; page/row lineage and repeated entries retained. No retail-make, assembly-location, model/year or VIN-to-HSN inference.
source.archiveStatus: Original PDF not redistributed; hash-pinned transformed factual row extract retained in Git only.

reuseAssessment.scope: Extract factual rows, transform into a database and redistribute the derived runtime in Python wheels/sdists, Java JARs, .NET NuGet and API/CLI results with source attribution and modification notices. No original PDF, logos or illustrations are distributed. Imported data retain KBA terms; orVIN CC0 applies only to original rights.
reuseAssessment.licenseIdentifier: LicenseRef-KBA-SV31-Attribution is an orVIN descriptive identifier for the cited publication notice, not an SPDX-listed license or a CC0 dedication.
reuseAssessment.notices: Preserve Kraftfahrt-Bundesamt attribution, product/edition, retrieval date, dataset and copyright-page links, and modification statement. No endorsement implied.
reuseAssessment.manualReview: New PDF editions, changed reuse terms and mappings require manual review; excluded from automatic structured-data refresh.

preferredAssignment.notes: NHTSA WMI row 4873. Historical validity and market exclusivity are not established. Make row 4657.

identityPreferences.reason: For WMI 1CA, orVIN explicitly prefers NHTSA's Cobra Industries make assignment over the conflicting KBA directory association with DaimlerChrysler/Dodge. This is a reviewed source preference, not proof that KBA is wrong or that Cobra belongs to Chrysler. Original KBA fields and HSN association remain separate evidence; no global manufacturer-name alias is created.
